title: Environmental and Social Impact Assessment of the Proposed Equiano Nigeria Submarine Cable Project in Lagos, Nigeria
lineage: October 2020 project draft prepared for WIOCC Nigeria Limited and Alcatel Submarine Networks, held by Nigeria’s Environmental Assessment Department.

passages.note: The project draft describes optical amplification as the repeater function and describes erbium-doped fibre as a feature of modern repeaters. The second observation is generic, with an industry reference, and this is a planning document. It is not an as-built component inventory.
